title: Florida House, District 14
what_it_does: Represents District 14 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Decided Aug. 18, 2026: Democratic Rep. Kimberly Daniels defeated her primary challenger and has no November opponent, so she is re-elected.
verified_ballot_note: CBS Miami / News Service of Florida (Aug. 19, 2026): 'Democratic Rep. Kim Daniels of Jacksonville defeated her primary challenger and will return to the House because she has no opponent in November' (https://www.cbsnews.com/miami/news/florida-house-senate-primary-election-results-2026/). Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Kimberly Daniels
candidates.background: Incumbent Democratic state representative from Jacksonville. Won the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary and faces no general-election opponent.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary (CBS Miami); unopposed in November
